name: top10
description: An OWASP Top 10 list with each category id, name, summary and the canonical URL. Lists: "web" (2021), "api" (2023), "llm" (LLM/GenAI applications 2025), "mobile" (2024). Use for awareness, mapping a finding to a category, or LLM-app threat modeling.

name: asvs_chapters
description: Table of contents for the OWASP ASVS 5.0 (Application Security Verification Standard): the 17 chapters (V1–V17) with names and requirement counts per assurance level. Use to discover which chapter to pull with asvs_requirements.

name: asvs_requirements
description: Testable security requirements from OWASP ASVS 5.0, each with its verification id (e.g. "V6.2.1"), section, level (L1/L2/L3) and text — the citable controls layer. Filter by chapter, level and/or keyword. Use to ground a control ("what does ASVS require for password storage?").

chapter.description: Chapter id like "V6" (Authentication). Omit to search all chapters.

level.description: Assurance level: 1 (essential), 2 (standard), 3 (advanced). Returns requirements applicable at or below this level.

query.description: Keyword filter on requirement text, e.g. "password", "TLS", "CSRF".

name: cheat_sheet
description: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series — concise, practical defensive guidance. With a topic, returns the matching cheat sheet as Markdown (or candidate matches if ambiguous). Without a topic, lists all available cheat sheets.

topic.description: Topic or sheet name, e.g. "SQL Injection", "JWT", "password storage". Omit to list all sheets.
